name.description:
Identifier that can be used to describe a set of instances.
Ex: "foo" can be used to describe the set { foo:1.0.0, foo:1.1.0 }.

sortableSemanticVersion.description:
A string sortable version of {@link #semanticVersion}.
See {@link SemanticVersion#toSortableString}.

dependencies.description:
Defines a map of {@link #name}s and the Semantic Version ranges which can serve as viable dependencies for this
{@link #semanticVersion}.
Ex:
```
{
  "ArtifactHub.Artifact#name": "Semantic Version Range",
  "foo": "8.1",
  "bar": "5.1",
}
```

title: Defines an interface for types that have dependencies specified as Semantic Version ranges.
name: WithDependencies
